finding_key: packages/docs/test/model/document.test.ts::the mixed-key branch of `styleoffasclear` (one style object containing both a style-supplied key and a non-supplied key) is never exercised, though the test comment claims it is
evidence: Verified against document.test.ts:345-367 and styleOffAsClear in document.ts: the test issues two separate applyInlineStyle calls ({italic:false} then {bold:false}) despite the line-360 comment claiming "in the same write". Traced the hypothesized regression (cleared = {} instead of { ...style }): both test calls and all other new single-key-patch tests still pass under it, since the spread only matters when one patch mixes a kept key and a cleared key. No combined boolean-off patch exists anywhere in the shown tests, so the mixed-key copy-on-write branch is genuinely unexercised. Real test-adequacy gap, though the production code itself is correct.
